fields.label: Event
fields.description: The moment the rep is told about, e.g. Lead::Assignment::assigned. Written by the rep's Notifications panel from the notification catalog — a value typed by hand that is not in the catalog matches nothing and notifies no one.

fields.label: Channel
fields.description: live delivers in-app while the rep has the app open, and a mobile push when they are away.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Unticked, the rep is not subscribed to this event.
